questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The angle of dip at the magnetic equator of the Earth is:
questions.explanation: At the magnetic equator the Earth's field is horizontal, so a freely suspended needle stays level and the dip is zero. At the magnetic poles the field is vertical and the dip is 90°.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 5: Magnetism and Matter

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The electric field due to an infinite plane sheet of uniform surface charge density σ is:
options: Proportional to the distance from the sheet
Independent of the distance from the sheet
Inversely proportional to the square of the distance
questions.explanation: Gauss's law gives E = σ/2ε₀, with no r in it at all. A line charge gives a field varying as 1/r and a point charge as 1/r², so the symmetry of the source decides the dependence.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 1: Electric Charges and Fields

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The coefficient of performance of a refrigerator working between a cold reservoir at T₂ and a hot reservoir at T₁ is:
questions.explanation: The coefficient of performance is the heat removed divided by the work done, and unlike an efficiency it can be greater than one. Trying to cool to a much lower T₂ makes it fall sharply.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: Chromatography is used to separate the components of a mixture on the basis of their:
options: Different distribution between a stationary phase and a mobile phase
questions.explanation: A component held more strongly by the stationary phase moves slowly and one held weakly moves fast, so the mixture separates along the plate or column.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 8: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Common salt is spread on icy roads in cold countries because adding a solute:
options: Raises the freezing point of water
Lowers the freezing point of water, so the ice melts
Raises the boiling point of water
Has no effect on the melting of ice
questions.explanation: Depression of freezing point is a colligative property, ΔTf = Kf × m, so salty water stays liquid below 0 °C. Since NaCl gives two ions per formula unit, it is doubly effective.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The formal charge on the central oxygen atom of the ozone molecule O₃ is:
questions.explanation: Formal charge = valence electrons - non-bonding electrons - half the bonding electrons. The central atom has one lone pair and three bonds, so it is 6 - 2 - 3 = +1, while the singly bonded terminal oxygen carries -1.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 4: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The red colour of the members of Rhodophyceae is mainly due to the predominance of the pigment:
questions.explanation: Red algae are mostly marine and grow in deeper water, since phycoerythrin absorbs the blue green light that penetrates to that depth. Agar and carrageenan come from them.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: According to Blackman's law of limiting factors, when several factors affect photosynthesis, the rate is determined by:
options: The factor present in the largest amount
The factor that is nearest its minimum value
The average of all the factors
questions.explanation: Raising any other factor will not help until the limiting one is improved, which is why increasing CO₂ in a greenhouse raises yield only when light and temperature are already adequate.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 11: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The micturition reflex, by which urine is voided, is triggered when:
options: Stretch receptors in the wall of the filled urinary bladder send signals to the central nervous system
The ureters contract on their own
Blood pressure in the glomerulus falls
questions.explanation: The CNS then makes the bladder muscle contract and the urethral sphincter relax. An adult passes about one to one and a half litres of urine a day.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 16: Excretory Products and their Elimination

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The largest phylum of the animal kingdom, which includes more than two thirds of all known animal species, is:
questions.explanation: Insects alone account for most of it. Arthropods have a chitinous exoskeleton, jointed appendages and an open circulatory system, and they occupy almost every habitat on Earth.
